title: The Ratchet of Logic
summary: Three Lean theorems of trureturing: adding theorems can only shrink the joint kernel of indistinguishable states; on a nondegenerate arena, a theorem lowers information escape exactly when it lies outside the semantic closure of the others; and the four-qubit Fredkin entangling-power conjecture is false. With the 720-hour commit cadence, 167,819 cumulative frozen theorems, 2,128 literature resolutions over 74 days, and the Riemann Hypothesis marked open.
summary_zh: trureturing 的三条 Lean 定理：增加定理只会缩小不可分辨状态对的联合核；在非退化竞技场上，一条定理降低信息逃逸，当且仅当它落在其余定理的语义闭包之外；四量子比特 Fredkin 纠缠能力猜想不成立。另附 720 个 UTC 小时连续提交节律、累计 167,819 条冻结定理、74 天 2,128 道文献题解，以及标为开放的黎曼猜想。
